question: What shared strategic risks affect Orion?
answer:
[community-1-1] [doc-028f3355f42924043f643c9b-0] Helios stores audit evidence in the Taiwan region. Helios has a single storage provider, Fabrikam. Fabrikam maintenance can make Helios unavailable. A second provider is proposed but has not been approved.
[doc-55933d15beb8cb706df05412-0] Contoso supplies compliance reviews for Orion. Contoso uses the Helios evidence platform to track audit evidence. A Helios outage delays compliance reviews and can block Orion releases.
[doc-8808b6306914858add5610f7-0] Northwind allocates its 2027 engineering budget to Orion reliability and Taiwan expansion. Contoso requires a recovery exercise for Helios before approving Orion expansion. Northwind must coordinate the recovery exercise with Contoso and Fabrikam.
[doc-934c56e176c7996380688f1e-0] Northwind sells the Orion analytics service to enterprise customers. Orion depends on Contoso for compliance reviews. Northwind plans to expand Orion into the Taiwan market in 2027.
